STEP 1 - Scene: A home-cooked dinner plate with roasted chicken pieces, roasted Brussels sprouts, sliced cucumber, and some mushrooms and a crumbly coating.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white square dinner plate, about 26 cm across. Area = 3.14 x 13^2 ≈ 530 cm^2. The partial plate at the bottom edge is not counted.

STEP 3 - Items: Roasted Brussels sprouts, two chicken pieces (one golden-browned, one paler with a crumb coating), sliced cucumber, dark roasted mushrooms, and a few crumbs or sauce bits.

STEP 4 - Area (about 41% of the plate is covered):
- Brussels sprouts: 8% (≈42 cm²)
- Chicken piece, top right: 12% (≈64 cm²)
- Chicken piece, bottom: 12% (≈64 cm²)
- Cucumber slices: 4% (≈21 cm²)
- Mushrooms: 3% (≈16 cm²)
- Crumbs/sauce: 2% (≈11 cm²)

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Sprouts: 42 cm² x 2 cm ≈ 85 ml
- Each chicken piece: 64 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 95 ml
- Cucumber: 21 cm² x 0.5 cm ≈ 11 ml
- Mushrooms: 16 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 24 ml
- Crumbs/sauce: 11 cm² x 0.5 cm ≈ 5 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Sprouts: 85 x 0.6 ≈ 51 g
- Each chicken piece: 95 x 0.95 ≈ 90 g
- Cucumber: 11 x 0.6 ≈ 6 g
- Mushrooms: 24 x 0.9 ≈ 22 g
- Crumbs/sauce: 5 x 1.0 ≈ 5 g
- Total ≈ 264 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Sprouts: 51 g x 40 kcal/100 g ≈ 20 kcal
- Chicken (top): 90 g x 200 kcal/100 g ≈ 180 kcal
- Chicken (bottom): 90 g x 200 kcal/100 g ≈ 180 kcal
- Cucumber: 6 g x 15 kcal/100 g ≈ 1 kcal
- Mushrooms: 22 g x 30 kcal/100 g ≈ 7 kcal
- Crumbs/sauce: 5 g x 150 kcal/100 g ≈ 8 kcal
- Total ≈ 396 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A plate about 40% covered with two chicken pieces and vegetables at roughly 260 g and 400 kcal is plausible. Scale uncertainty is significant, so treat these as rough estimates.
